Sites example data

Source: R/data.R
data_Sites.Rd

A dataset with example site information for use with the getSiteInfo function.

data_Sites

Format

A data frame with 2,244 observations on the following 23 variables:

STATION_CD

Station Code

STATION_CD

Station Code

STATION_NAME

Station Name

COMID

Associated NHD+v2 COMID

STATION_RID

a numeric vector

HUC12

12 digit Hydrologic Unit Code

COUNTY_NAME

County Name

STATION_TYPE

Station Type

LATITUDE

Latitude

LONGITUDE

Longitude

UTM_EAST

UTM Easting

UTM_NORTH

UTM Northing

UTM_ZONE

UTM Zone 11N 12N

Elevation

Elevation

ReferenceStatus

Reference Status reference Reference

Year

Year

StationID_Master

StationID Master Code

FinalLatitude

Final Latitude

FinalLongitude

Final Longitude

WaterbodyName

Waterbody Name

GIS_County

County; derived from GIS

CARefSite_2017

a character vector

COMID_NHD2

a numeric vector

ElevCategory

Elevation Category; Hi or Lo, break point at 5,000 ft

Source

example data
